top_signals.title: 10-Year Treasury Yield Rises to Highest Since 2007
top_signals.summary: Yields on the benchmark 10-year Treasury note rose to the highest level since 2007 as a rally in oil prices fueled inflation concerns and strengthened bets on a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike. Bloomberg MLIV's Ven Ram has the latest. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
